title: GetServerStatus
description: We will send server information to Discord using discordSRV.
body:
# GetServerStatus

`GetServerStatus` is a plugin for Spigot/Paper that allows you to check the status of your Minecraft server directly from Discord.

When you send `getstatus` in the main Discord channel, the bot returns server information in an embedded message.

## Features

* Current number of online players
* List of online player names
* TPS
* MSPT
* Memory usage
* CPU usage

## Requirements

* Minecraft 1.18 or later
* `DiscordSRV`
* `spark`

## Usage

1. Install this plugin on your server.
2. Install `DiscordSRV` and `spark`, then start the server.
3. Send `getstatus` in the main DiscordSRV channel.
4. The bot will reply with the server status in an embed.

## Notes

* This plugin only monitors messages in the main DiscordSRV channel.
* The embed color changes based on TPS as an indicator of server performance.
* It seems that starting from version 1.21 the following flag is required `-Dpaper.preferSparkPlugin=true`

## Support

If you have any questions, please contact us on Discord.
